items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer states 'Peck Morrison was the bass player... in Tiny Bradshaw's band' and 'I saw some guys up there my age'. The interviewee (Sam Jones) does not claim a personal relationship, only that he saw him in the band.

ctx.x: Up there--150th Street between Broadway and Amsterdam and got my bag. And we split. And Peck Morrison was the bass player and, and, in Tiny Bradshaw's band but he was quitting because he had something to do here in New York.
